name: Plate Tectonics
summary: The unifying theory of the solid Earth: how lithospheric plates move, interact and build continents and ocean basins.

topics.name: From continental drift to seafloor spreading: history of the theory
Lithosphere and asthenosphere; oceanic versus continental lithosphere
Marine magnetic anomalies and seafloor ages
Plate kinematics: Euler poles, relative and absolute motion
Divergent boundaries: mid-ocean ridges and continental rifts
Convergent boundaries: subduction zones, arcs and collision
Driving forces: ridge push, slab pull and mantle convection
